name: Faint-spotted Palthis
desc: Faint-spotted Palthis (Palthis asopialis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Palthis asopialis, the faint-spotted palthis moth, is a moth of the family Erebidae. The species was first described by Achille Guenée in 1854.
